channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Afghanistan, West Indies meet in 2nd warm-up match today
item.description: Afghanistan are all set to take on West Indies in their second warm-up match of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup today (Wednesday) at the BCCI Centre of Excellence Ground 1 in Bengaluru, India.

item.title: 4th Doha working group meeting held in Kabul
item.description: The fourth meeting of Doha process working group on counter-narcotics, hosted by the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA), has been held in the capital Kabul in both physical and virtual formats, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) announced on Wednesday.

item.title: 420 killed, injured by unexploded ordnance in Afghanistan
item.description: At least 87 people were killed and 333 others injured in 193 incidents involving unexploded ordnance across Afghanistan over the past year, the Afghanistan National Disaster Management Authority (ANDMA) said on Wednesday.

item.title: Mobile teams resume health services in deprived areas of Nimroz after Pajhwok report
item.description: Mobile health teams have resumed operations in remote areas of the capital of southwestern Nimroz province after months of suspension following publication of Pajhwok Afghan News reports about the lack of basic services, particularly healthcare.

item.title: Over 6,000kg of narcotics torched in Ghor
item.description: More than 6,200 kilogrammes of various types of narcotics were set alight in western Ghor province on Wednesday, an official said.

item.title: ANDMA inks $722,000 trilateral agreement with 2 NGOs
item.description: The Afghanistan National Disaster Management Authority (ANDMA) has inked a trilateral agreement with Solidarités International (SI) and Handicap International (HI) worth 722,000 US dollars.

item.title: UAE frees 108 Afghan prisoners on National Day
item.description: Afghanistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs says the leadership of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), on the occasion of the country’s National Day, has released around 108 Afghan prisoners from its prisons.

item.title: Iran-US nuclear talks to be held in Oman this week
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has confirmed that nuclear talks between Iran and the United States will take place this week in Oman, Al Jazeera has reported.

item.title: Trump, Xi discuss Ukraine war, Iran situation
item.description: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping have discussed key issues, including trade, Taiwan, Russia’s war in Ukraine and the current situation in Iran.

item.title: Afghanistan contact group meeting scheduled for Feb. 16 in Astana
item.description: A meeting of the special envoys’ contact group on Afghanistan is scheduled to be held in Astana, the capital of Kazakhstan, on 16 February, media reports said on Thursday.
